{{External|rs=Lunar spells}}
[[File:Lunar spellbook.png|left|The Lunar spellbook icon.]]
[[File:Lunar spells.png|frame|The Lunar spellbook.]]
The '''Lunar spellbook''' is a [[spellbook]] that players can access upon completion of the [[quest]] [[Lunar Diplomacy]], associated with the magicks of the [[Moon Clan]]. Making extensive use of [[astral rune]]s, the spellbook is primarily oriented towards utility spells and combat-support spells, reducing or eliminating the need for certain items and equipment to carry out certain tasks. A larger set of spells is accessible to players who have completed the quest [[Dream Mentor]] and two additional spells are available for completing the [[Hard Fremennik Diary]].

The spells in this spellbook use all rune types except [[wrath rune|wrath]].

65 Magic and 40 Defence without boosts are required to cast any Lunar spell. Although it is not normally possible to unlock the spellbook without those requirements, if the quest was auto-completed with the [[Fremennik quest lamp]], or if the player lost experience on death in those skills in past [[Deadman Mode]] events, Lunar spells cannot be cast until the level requirements are met.

==Switching spellbooks==
Players can pray at the [[Astral Altar]] on the south-east end of [[Lunar Isle]] to switch between the Lunar spellbook and the [[Standard spellbook]]. Astral runes can also be crafted at this altar using the [[Runecraft]] skill; players cannot craft astral runes through [[The Abyss]]. An easy way to travel to the Lunar Isle is by using a [[Lunar isle teleport]] scroll or a [[Moonclan Teleport (tablet)|Moonclan teleport]] tablet. If you intend to change your spellbook, be sure to bring a teleport to leave the island.

Players who have level 80 in [[Construction]] (or 75 with a +5 [[spicy stew]] boost) can build a [[lunar altar]] within their [[Achievement Gallery]], allowing them to freely switch between the standard and lunar spellbooks without having to travel to the Astral Altar. The crystal saw's +3 boost cannot be combined with the spicy stew's +5 boost since the achievement gallery requires 80 Construction, and the saw's boost does not work on adding new rooms to your POH.

Visiting a POH with an [[Occult altar]] allows players to immediately switch between the spellbooks, including Lunar.

===Teleport spells===
The Lunar spellbook contains a relatively small number of teleportation spells, comparable in number to the [[Ancient spellbook]]. These spells are mostly to locations directly associated with the Moonclan and Fremmenik, or indirectly, for example through being associated with Runecraft or Fishing. The spellbook also uniquely contains Tele Group spells, which teleport the caster alongside anyone within a 3x3 [[game square|tile]] area around them - the caster is teleported immediately, players in the area must have [[Accept Aid]] on and accept the teleport from a menu that pops up.

==Trivia==
*While the player requires runes to cast Lunar spells, the peoples of the [[Moon Clan]] have advanced their magical abilities to the point they no longer require runes to channel their magic.{{CiteText|text=Baba Yaga|quote=Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to our advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory.}}
*The only spells in the Lunar spellbook that do not use [[astral rune]]s are [[Teleport to Target]], which is shared with other spellbooks; and [[Lunar Home Teleport]] and [[Minigame Teleport]], which are free.
